addition to the standard Sudoku rules, the cells inside the grey outlines must add up to the numbers shown in the corner, and each grey‑lined shape may not contain any repeated digit.

This means that within every shape formed by the grey lines, each digit from one to nine can appear at most once.

If you want to see the completed solution, purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition.

Enjoy solving the challenge and check back later for the answer."
